findings.title: No signed MAVLink frames
findings.detail: 0/7489 frames carry a MAVLink 2 signature. Commands and telemetry on this link have no cryptographic integrity or origin authentication.
cra_refs: Annex I.I.2(d) protection from unauthorised access
Annex I.I.2(f) integrity of data and commands
findings.recommendation: Enable MAVLink 2 message signing with a per-vehicle key and a key-provisioning process.

advisories.summary: CISA ICSA-26-090-02: missing authentication for critical function in PX4 MAVLink (CWE-306, CVSS v3 9.8). Remediation: enable MAVLink 2 signing on non-USB links.

findings.title: MAVLink FTP advertised on an unsigned link
findings.detail: The vehicle advertises MAV_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY_FTP and this link accepts unauthenticated peers, so the file-transfer service is reachable without the signing key.
cra_refs: Annex I.I.2(d) protection from unauthorised access
findings.recommendation: Enable signing; disable or restrict MAVLink FTP in production builds where not needed.

findings.title: Firmware version identified
findings.detail: px4 firmware 1.17.0 (type 255). Track it against vendor advisories and the SBOM.
cra_refs: Annex I.I.2(a) no known exploitable vulnerabilities
findings.recommendation: Keep firmware on a supported release and monitor advisories (NVD, vendor GHSA).

findings.title: No link-layer confidentiality
findings.detail: MAVLink signing provides integrity only; payloads (position, mission, parameters) are sent in clear unless the radio link is encrypted.
findings.recommendation: Use an encrypted datalink (e.g. AES-capable radio) or a VPN/tunnel for IP links; assess per threat model.

findings.title: Vehicle answers unsigned requests
findings.detail: An unsigned PARAM_REQUEST_READ (index:0) was answered by system 1 with PARAM_VALUE. Unsigned peers are served by the parameter protocol, so they can at least read configuration.
cra_refs: Annex I.I.2(d) protection from unauthorised access
findings.recommendation: Enable signing on the vehicle so unsigned messages are rejected.

disclaimer: CRA references map findings to Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 Annex I as a technical interpretation; they are not legal advice or a conformity assessment.
